set.body:
Outcome

Compile raw scientific values into an always-valid bound plan.

Acceptance

- Binding checks exact axes, target alignment, design population, measurement ownership, and estimand-required capabilities.
- Failures are closed ADTs with actionable context and tested rendering.
- No Boolean requiresFolds, optional-plan sentinel, thrown exception, or string-only failure crosses the boundary.
- Bound plans cannot be constructed through public unsafe constructors.
set.title: P2.3: implement identity and capability binding with structured errors
